case_number: 2025 INSC 127; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 5067 of 2024)

parties.respondent: STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH AND ANOTHER

summary: Summoning order without reasons; violation of Section 204 CrPC; magistrate must apply mind and record basis for prima facie case; precedent from Pepsi Foods, Sunil Bharti Mittal, Lalankumar Singh; non-speaking order set aside; criminal proceedings quashed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order upholding criminal proceedings set aside; criminal proceedings quashed for lack of reasoned summoning order.
